content: {"argument": "The behavior change is intentional and follows logically from the modified condition. Previously, the code checked `options.keepQueryParameters.length > 0`, meaning an empty array would skip the filtering loop and preserve all query parameters. The change to `length > -1` ensures the loop runs even for empty arrays, causing all non-matching (i.e., all) parameters to be deleted since none satisfy the keep condition. This aligns with the purpose of `keepQueryParameters`: to retain only listed parameters, so an empty list correctly results in no parameters retained.", "concedes": false}
